sources: AMC Entertainment Q4 and full-year 2025 results (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1, Feb 23, 2026): attendance 219.4M, average ticket $12.09, food & beverage per patron $7.62, admissions $2,652.8M, food & beverage revenue $1,671.3M, film exhibition costs $1,275.2M, food & beverage costs $327.0M, net loss $632.4M: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1411579/000141157926000018/amc-20260223xex99d1.htm

Our calculations from the same release: film costs / admissions = 48.1%; food & beverage costs / food & beverage revenue = 19.6%; per person after direct costs: ticket $12.09 x (1 - 0.481) = $6.28, snacks $7.62 x (1 - 0.196) = $6.13 (before rent and staff).
title: Where your movie ticket money really goes #shorts
summary: About 48% of AMC's box office money went to the movie studios in 2025.

scenes.narration: An average AMC ticket cost {$12.09|twelve dollars and nine cents} in {2025.|twenty twenty-five.}
About {$5.81|five eighty-one} of it went straight to the movie studios.
So the cinema needs another way to pay the bills.
It's in your hands right now.
